instruction: A warehouse starts with 1890 boxes. It receives 3 deliveries of 50 boxes each. Then the stock is split equally into 3 warehouses and it keeps one share (rounded down). It ships 17 boxes per day for 4 days. Then the stock is split equally into 0 warehouses and it keeps one share (rounded down). How many boxes does it have at the end? Compute it with the bash tool (python3 -c). Work only inside the current directory. When you are done, write ONLY the final answer to the file answer.txt in the current directory.
